Clear silhouette difference from Idle through low-forward shoulder/head thrust and spread hind support, not rotated/rescaled copy.
Crisp large angular painted forms, restrained solid near-black overlap masses, limited matte grey/taupe planes, no grain or added fur slash texture. Use only a few bold fur clumps, avoid dozens of tiny spikes. No new costume/accessories, no cute eyes/grin, no special effects, no motion streaks, no scenery, no floor or shadow. Single full-body dog on genuine transparent canvas. Maintain same source-camera proportion and dog identity across both paintings.
